meta.purpose: Bounded identity ingestion of externally produced existing native logs, never command execution or diagnostic correctness.

atlas_source_correspondence.text_identity: Reuse the original bounded source byte read, strict UTF-8 text with BOM/newlines preserved, and source_snapshot_store_policy content identity. No target reread, timestamp fallback or sampled hash.
atlas_source_correspondence.boundary: The raw native-run authority remains unestablished. COMPLETE lineage establishes only exact receipt and declared source text correspondence with the consumed Atlas snapshot. All source rows must MATCH; no config, full-input, historical execution or diagnostic causal claim.

source_correspondence.normalization: Windows host case and separators only; no relative, alias, URL, query, fragment or filesystem resolution
source_correspondence.ambiguous_lists: Comma-space importer fields remain AMBIGUOUS_LIST even if a declared filename matches the whole field
source_correspondence.boundary: Reported identifier correspondence only. Read current MATCH/MISMATCH/UNAVAILABLE from the referenced input row; this does not prove historical bytes, import edges, causal production faults or Atlas lineage.

vite_5_4_21_mixed_import_console_v1.boundary: Exact single-line reporter warning with optional SGR colors and CRLF. Wrapped, translated or changed formats are not inferred. Tool/run metadata remains caller-reported; warning bytes do not prove source edges, production faults or performance impact.

claim_boundary: INGESTED means the supplied stream bytes match their caller-reported hashes. Tool, command, timestamps and exit code remain unverified declarations. Current source/config byte correspondence is not historical run proof, complete compiler inputs, Atlas lineage, clean diagnostics, changed-effect coverage or production attribution. Raw command, source and log content is not persisted in this receipt. Ordinary bounded local input only; no hostile-input isolation or confidentiality guarantee.
